author: bardic-inspiration
name: Orc War-Chanter
summary: An orc drum-priest whose chanting hardens the warband and cows its enemies.
description: A war-chanter's voice carries over the roar of battle. The chant is older than the clan, and when it stops the warband usually does too.

traits.name: Battle Chant
traits.text: Each ally within 30 feet of the war-chanter has {ref:glossary/advantage} on saving throws against the {ref:condition/frightened} condition while the war-chanter is conscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The war-chanter makes two Spear attacks.

actions.name: Roar of the Horde
actions.onFailure: The target also has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition until the end of the war-chanter's next turn.

bonusActions.name: Aggressive
bonusActions.text: The war-chanter moves up to its Speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
